evidence.action: Read GetCompletedFrameStats() from ProjectGame::PreUpdate during a 220-frame standalone run.
evidence.expected: A valid snapshot of the previous completed render with a changing frame index and nonzero counters, rather than zeroed current-frame stats.
evidence.actual: At PreUpdate frame 60, valid=1, frameIndex=59, DrawCalls=8, InstancesDrawn=18. At frame 110, valid=1, frameIndex=109, DrawCalls=9, InstancesDrawn=19.

evidence.action: Enable diagnostics overlay in game code and capture frame at camera Y=24.
evidence.expected: Explain total 13 as 11 drawn plus one hidden and one frustum-culled; show per-LOD counts and thresholds.
evidence.actual: Frame 59: drawn=11/13, hidden=1, distanceCulled=0, frustumCulled=1, perLOD=(0,0,11), thresholds=(9,17), drawDistance=60, camera distance 24.5967..46.545. BMP visibly contains the readable panel.

evidence.action: Move SceneCamera from Y=24 to Y=8 in the isolated harness; capture a second frame.
evidence.expected: A completed frame at a closer camera distance selects a nearer LOD bucket while preserving cull accounting.
evidence.actual: Frame 109: drawn=11/13, hidden=1, distanceCulled=0, frustumCulled=1, perLOD=(0,11,0), thresholds=(9,17), drawDistance=60, camera distance 9.96996..40.7534. BMP visibly contains the updated panel.

evidence.action: Observe overlay and data through game API and frame dump; do not drive the interactive window.
evidence.expected: F7 toggles panel visibility; F8 changes selected InstancedMeshComponent.
evidence.actual: Not manually exercised. Panel was enabled through SetRenderDiagnosticsVisible(true); scene has one instanced component, so F8 selection was not needed for this scenario.

limitations: Two visible LOD buckets (LOD2 and LOD1) were observed; LOD0 was not exercised.
Final Runtime/SDK rebuild and rerun after the shader-cache integration adjustment completed successfully with the same measured results.
FrameDump verifies a rendered panel, not interactive F7/F8 behavior or user input focus.
